blocks.plainText: For zoning lots with residential and community facility uses, front yards shall be provided pursuant to Article II, Chapter 3, where applicable, and side yards and rear yards shall be provided in accordance with this Chapter. The building articulation provisions of paragraph (b) of Section 23-426 (Additional height and setback provisions) shall apply to zoning lots with residential and community facility uses.

blocks.html: For the residential portion of a building with both residential and community facility uses, the required residential rear yard shall be provided at the floor level of the lowest story used for dwelling units, where any window of such dwelling units faces onto such rear yard.
